756922.name: Cheder Chabad of Monsey Girls School
756922.note: Monsey (no shetach). The Chabad Chinuch Office's Directory of Chabad Educational Institutions lists 'Cheder Chabad of Monsey - Girls, 25 South Monsey Road, Airmont, NY 10952 ... Founded: 1999' (2023-24; Judaic Studies Principal Mrs. Chaya Rosenbluh), and its 2012-13 edition the same ('Girls' division, Principal: Mrs. Chaya Rosenbluh, 25 S. Monsey Rd, Airmont ... Founded 1999, 1-8'; https://www.chinuchoffice.org/media/pdf/352/Ocxs3521475.pdf). Medium: the boys' division and the Cheder itself are also 1999, so the year may be the school's rather than the girls' division's own. Its chabad.org listing went up on Oct 28 2008; in Sept 2014 the Cheder had a 'boys division and girls division' (CrownHeights.info).
